description: PreToolUse — ticket guard for subagents: in a session where /kensei-toolkit:ticket is active, subagents may not commit, push, write to the tracker, send mail or chat messages, or start remote or scheduled work; subagent-guard.sh exits at once for main-session calls, unmarked sessions or a missing guard.py, so Python starts only for subagent calls in a ticket session. Stop — board nudge: in a session bound to a task board by /kensei-toolkit:board, a turn that did work without updating the board is handed back once; board-nudge.sh exits at once for sessions without a board marker, so Python starts only in board sessions.
